notes: Searches for Virudhunagar district / Sivakasi / Srivilliputhur / Rajapalayam data centre, datacenter, server farm, hyperscale and colocation terms found no public facility or announced project in the district. name: AWS Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) Region
developer: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Data Services India)
notes: AWS official blog: 30th AWS region (ap-south-2) with three Availability Zones went live in Hyderabad/Telangana in November 2022; first announced November 2020. Campus locations include Chandanvelly (Ranga Reddy district, ~98 acres allotted). MW capacity not disclosed.

name: AWS $7 billion Hyderabad/Telangana data centre expansion (agreement with Telangana government)
notes: AWS signed an agreement with the Government of Telangana (Dec 2025) to invest USD 7 billion (~Rs 60,000 crore) in cloud/AI data centre infrastructure in Hyderabad over the next ~14 years, with state facilitation measures. Follows the Jan 2025 Davos commitment announced by the CM. Capacity in MW not disclosed.

name: Amazon hyperscale data centre campus at Bharat Future City / Chandanvelly
notes: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy performed the symbolic groundbreaking (Mar 2025) for Amazon's hyperscale data centre at Bharat Future City near Hyderabad, where AWS has been allotted 98 acres at Chandanvelly (Ranga Reddy district). Supports AWS cloud/AI growth; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Azure India South Central (Hyderabad) cloud region
notes: Microsoft announced general availability of its India South Central region in Hyderabad (Aug 2026), its fourth India region; three availability zones with air-cooled chillers (zero-water cooling). Part of Microsoft's ~USD 20.5 billion India cloud/AI investment. Early customers include HDFC Bank, Adani Digital Lab, Bajaj Finance, PB Pay. MW capacity not disclosed.

name: Microsoft Mekaguda/Shadnagar/Chandanvelly data centre campus expansion (incl. three additional ~100MW data centres)
notes: Microsoft acquired land parcels of 22 acres at Mekaguda village, 41 acres at Shadnagar and 52 acres at Chandanvelly (all Ranga Reddy district) for its largest India data centre region; HYD01 (Mekaguda campus) is part of the now-live Azure region. Reports (2025) say Microsoft will add three more ~100MW data centre projects in Telangana. Exact MW per site not disclosed.

name: CtrlS Rated-4 data centre, Hyderabad Financial District
notes: CtrlS official page: Rated-4 data centre in Hyderabad's Financial District with 13 MW IT load and multi-zone security, offering colocation. Hyderabad-based CtrlS is one of India's largest colocation operators.

name: CtrlS Data Centre Park, Chandanvelly Industrial Park (up to 600MW)
notes: CtrlS announced (Jan 2025) a 40-acre data centre park at the upcoming Chandanvelly Industrial Park near Hyderabad (Ranga Reddy district), with potential IT load of ~600MW when fully developed across multiple AI-ready, high-density buildings. CtrlS also signed an MoU with the Telangana government (at WEF Davos, Jan 2025) for an AI-ready data centre cluster with proposed investment of over Rs 10,000 crore.

name: AirTrunk HYD1 (ex-Lumina CloudInfra) Chandanvelly campus
notes: DataCenterMap lists AirTrunk HYD1 at Chandanvelly, Hyderabad with >243MW total capacity on a 13.3-hectare site (179,000 sq m built-up). Livemint reported Lumina CloudInfra had two Hyderabad data centre sites under construction; AirTrunk entered India by acquiring Lumina CloudInfra (announced Nov 2025) with ~600MW of planned India capacity. Exact phase status to be confirmed; treat MW as campus design capacity.

name: Nxtra by Airtel Hyderabad hyperscale data centre (up to 200MW)
notes: Airtel's Nxtra announced (Dec 2022) a hyperscale data centre in Hyderabad on ~40 acres with Rs 2,000 crore investment; first phase ~60MW IT load, campus planned up to 200MW. Nxtra CEO said the Hyderabad facility should be operational within ~2 years and at full capacity in ~5 years. Status reported by press as under development.

name: STT GDC Hyderabad 1 (HYS 1) existing facility
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
notes: DataCenterMap lists ~42 facilities in Hyderabad; Blackridge Research lists STT Hyderabad 1 at ~4 MW IT capacity. STT GDC has operated in Hyderabad; exact address and current MW not confirmed by primary source in this check.

name: STT GDC AI-ready data centre campus, Mucherla/Meerkhanpet (100MW, Rs 3,500 crore MoU)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
notes: Telangana government signed an MoU with STT GDC India (2025) to build an AI-ready data centre campus of ~100MW with Rs 3,500 crore investment at Mucherla/Meerkhanpet in Ranga Reddy district (Hyderabad IT hub). MoU stage - location, capacity and timeline to be confirmed.

name: NTT Data / Neysa Networks 400MW AI data centre cluster, Hyderabad
developer: NTT Data, Neysa Networks (tripartite MoU with Telangana government)
notes: Tripartite MoU signed in Tokyo (18 Apr 2025) between NTT Data, Neysa Networks and the Telangana government for a 400MW AI data centre cluster in Hyderabad with Rs 10,500 crore (~USD 1.2bn) investment, designed to host ~25,000 GPUs for AI supercomputing. MoU stage; site within Hyderabad metro not specified.

name: AdaniConneX Hyderabad campus, Pargi Road (Elkatta)
notes: DataCenterMap lists AdaniConneX Hyderabad at Pargi Road, Elkatta (southern Hyderabad / Ranga Reddy periphery) with ~100MW IT load design. Phase 1 (9.6MW) reported operational during 2024 with further phases under construction; one source cites a planned 600MW campus and Baxtel reports an Adani 48MW data centre in Telangana. Verify capacity figures; grade C.

name: Princeton Digital Group (PDG) Hyderabad campus HY1 (90MW)
notes: PDG announced (late 2025) a multi-site India expansion securing land for a 90MW, three-building campus in Hyderabad (HY1) as part of a 210MW two-campus plan. Announcement covered by trade analysts' posts; no dedicated press release found in this check - treat as unconfirmed planned project (grade C).

name: UPC Volt 100MW data centre (MoU with Telangana government, Davos)
notes: UPC Volt signed an MoU with the Telangana government at Davos (Jan 2026) for a 100MW data centre with ~Rs 50 billion (USD 544m) proposed investment over 5+ years. Location within Telangana and capacity details not disclosed by the parties.

name: Telangana Data Centre City, Aloor village (Chevella mandal)
notes: Telangana government planning India's first dedicated data centre city on ~1,500 acres at Aloor village, Chevella mandal near Hyderabad (Ranga Reddy district); CM directed preparation of a detailed report; state to supply treated water (~530 MLD to Chandanvelly and Bharat Future City industrial clusters) and consider open-access power. 5GW of data centre capacity reported in pipeline across Telangana. Concept stage.

name: Telangana State Data Centre (TSDC)
developer: Government of Telangana (Telangana State Technology Services / IT department)
notes: State-run Telangana State Data Centre in Hyderabad hosts state government services; reported operating with ~99.74% uptime. Capacity and address not disclosed in the checked public source; grade C.

name: Pi Datacenters Hyderabad facility (USD 24m)
notes: Pi Datacenters announced a ~USD 24m Hyderabad data centre (Uptime Institute Tier III design-compliant build-to-suit) which will also host its AI Cloud offering and serve as Pi's headquarters; investment spread over two years. Pi operates a Tier IV campus in Visakhapatnam and has a Hyderabad presence. Capacity MW not disclosed.

name: Sify Technologies Hyderabad data centre (colocation)
notes: DataCenterMap lists Sify among operators with colocation facilities in Hyderabad (~42 facilities listed for the city across 5 operators); DataCenterJournal notes Sify Technologies among major Indian DC operators. Capacity not disclosed; grade C.
